# QA Report

## Verdict: CONDITIONAL PASS

## Summary

The core fix is correctly implemented and verifiable in code and in the compiled CSS. The `title={c.tip}` attribute is fully removed from all four benchmark column `<th>` elements, and the Tailwind `group/info` named-group CSS pattern is compiled and correctly scoped — `group-hover/info:opacity-100` fires only when hovering the `<span class="group/info relative">` icon wrapper, not the parent `<th>` or surrounding label text. The no-regression surface is clean: the ScoreBar, data cells, "Our Score" column, and compact mode are all untouched. However, there is a structural CSS concern about tooltip visibility that must be verified in a real browser before this is marked fully passing.

## Defects Found

**P2-01: Tooltip may be clipped by `overflow-x-auto` scroll container**

The tooltip span (`position: absolute; bottom-full`) is rendered _above_ the `<thead>` row, but its nearest positioned ancestor (`<span class="group/info relative">`) lives inside `<div class="overflow-x-auto">`. Per CSS spec, when `overflow-x: auto` is set and `overflow-y` is `visible`, the browser computes `overflow-y` as `auto`, turning the div into a scroll container that clips all overflow including absolutely positioned descendants. Since the table fills the `overflow-x-auto` div from the very top (no padding or leading content within that div), the tooltip extends _above_ the scroll container's clip edge and may be invisible on all browsers. This needs direct browser verification — if the tooltip is clipped, no user can see it and the feature effectively doesn't work.

**Reproduction path:** Load the dashboard, hover the ⓘ icon on any benchmark column header (GPQA, SWE-bench, Arena Elo, OSWorld), observe whether the tooltip renders or is cut off at the top of the table.

**Suggested fix if confirmed:** Add `overflow: visible` on the `<thead>` or wrap the `overflow-x-auto` with a relative container and move the tooltip to be a sibling of the table wrapper rather than a child of a `<th>`.

---

**P3-01: Info icon has no accessible label**

The inline SVG has no `aria-label`, `role="img"`, or `<title>` element. Screen readers will skip it silently, leaving no way to discover the benchmark description non-visually. The old `title` attribute at least provided this. Out of stated task scope but a regression in accessibility.

## Recommendation

**CONDITIONAL PASS** — Approve on the condition that the tooltip is verified visible in Chrome and Firefox at desktop width. The `title`-attribute removal and `group/info` hover scoping are correct. If browser testing confirms P2-01 (tooltip clipped), this must return to dev for a fix before shipping.
